style: retro 16-bit pixel art, dark fantasy night palette, hard 1-pixel edges, clean dark outline, flat shading with at most 3 tones per material, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no glow, no soft shadows

tower.desc: the body of a tall, chunky, powerful ROUND stone tower: a perfectly cylindrical, smoothly curved circular tower (clearly round, NOT square, NOT octagonal, NOT hexagonal, no flat straight faces) built from rings of big bold curved brick blocks, slightly wider at the base and tapering a little toward the top, with a wide round crenellated top rim with chunky battlements, a wide flat round roof deck inside the battlements, one BIG bright glowing yellow arched window in the middle, a few mossy patches, and a ring of stone ledge corbels so that several flat empty stone platforms are clearly visible on the roof deck and on two small balconies jutting out at both sides where weapons could be bolted on. NO legs and NO feet: the bottom edge is a flat stone base. It looks sturdy, heavy, tall and a little bit alive

zombie.desc: a small shambling green-skinned zombie with tattered clothes, arms stretched forward, tiny red eyes; front view with a gentle top-down 3/4 RPG perspective, facing right

xp.desc: a small faceted glowing blue crystal gem, bright highlight on the upper left

arrow.desc: a single wooden arrow pointing exactly to the right, steel arrowhead on the right end, feather fletching on the left end, drawn perfectly horizontal

ground.desc: a seamless tileable top-down ground tile of dark blue-grey night soil with a few tiny pebbles and one or two sparse dark-green grass tufts

smith.desc: strip of 3 frames (idle, walk A, walk B), each 26x26: a stocky bald bearded blacksmith, rust-red shirt, brown leather apron, dark boots, empty hands, facing right. Built by hand from one Gemini sheet (art-src/sheet_smith.jpg) with the split script, not by downscale.py

tree.desc: (set) 4 tree variants from art-src/sheet_trees.jpg via split3.py: tree (oak), tree_pine, tree_birch, tree_autumn; rocks rock/rock_moss/rock_pair/rock_tall from sheet_rocks.jpg; grass_*/fern from sheet_plants.jpg

rock.desc: a plain grey stone boulder, three-quarter top-down RPG angle

leg.desc: a single thick gnarled wooden tree-root leg of a giant walking tower, front view, wide knobbly root-foot at the bottom with small root toes, thick brown bark with lighter highlights, a flat top edge where it attaches to the stone body, chunky and strong

w_ballista.desc: a small chunky wooden ballista crossbow turret on a stone-grey mount, loaded with a big bolt pointing right, seen from a three-quarter top-down RPG angle (camera looking down from above and slightly in front, so the top surface and front are both visible)

w_cannon.desc: a small chunky black iron fire cannon with glowing orange ember in the muzzle on a stone-grey mount pointing right, seen from a three-quarter top-down RPG angle (camera looking down from above and slightly in front, so the top surface and front are both visible)

w_coil.desc: a small chunky tesla lightning coil: copper wire wrapped pillar topped with a bright cyan electric orb with tiny sparks, on a stone-grey base, seen from a three-quarter top-down RPG angle (camera looking down from above and slightly in front, so the top surface and front are both visible)

w_frost.desc: a small chunky frost spire: a cluster of pale icy-blue crystals growing from a stone-grey base, bright white highlights, seen from a three-quarter top-down RPG angle (camera looking down from above and slightly in front, so the top surface and front are both visible)

w_catapult.desc: a small chunky wooden catapult with a loaded round boulder in its spoon arm, on a stone-grey base pointing right, seen from a three-quarter top-down RPG angle (camera looking down from above and slightly in front, so the top surface and front are both visible)

w_orb.desc: a small chunky floating arcane orb: a swirling purple and magenta-free violet sphere hovering above a small stone-grey pedestal, with a bright white core, seen from a three-quarter top-down RPG angle (camera looking down from above and slightly in front, so the top surface and front are both visible)

p_fire.desc: a round blazing fireball with a bright yellow core, orange body and red edge, tiny flame tail on the left

p_bolt.desc: a single vertical jagged lightning bolt, bright white core with cyan edge, zigzag shape

p_shard.desc: a single sharp ice shard pointing exactly to the right, pale blue with white highlights

p_rock.desc: a round grey rough boulder rock with chunky cracks and a lighter top-left highlight

p_orb.desc: a glowing violet arcane energy ball with a bright white centre and a soft darker violet rim

ore_copper.desc: a grey boulder with chunky bright orange copper ore patches and a few green verdigris spots

ore_iron.desc: a dark slate boulder with pale silver-blue iron streaks and glints

crystal_node.desc: a small dark rock with a cluster of glowing cyan crystal shards growing out of it

ic_wood.desc: a short brown wood log showing a lighter round cut end

ic_iron.desc: a pale silver-blue iron ingot bar

grass.desc: a seamless tileable top-down grass ground tile in muted natural green with subtle darker and lighter patches, a few tiny blade marks and dark clover patches

tree_pine.desc: a tall conifer pine tree (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

tree_birch.desc: a slim birch tree with white bark (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

tree_autumn.desc: a twisted autumn tree with orange and red leaves (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

rock_moss.desc: a mossy boulder with a tiny fern (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

rock_pair.desc: a pair of small grey stones (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

rock_tall.desc: a tall angular rock formation (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

grass_tall.desc: a tall lush grass clump (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

grass_daisy.desc: a grass tuft with tiny white daisies (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

grass_violet.desc: a grass tuft with purple flowers (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

grass_mush.desc: a grass tuft with two red mushrooms (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)

fern.desc: a small green fern (cut from a Gemini sheet by tools/split3.py)
